name: LearnMate
description: AI-powered career guidance agent that helps students discover career paths and build personalized learning roadmaps. Powered by IBM watsonx.ai.

IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY.description: IBM Cloud API key with access to watsonx.ai. Get it from cloud.ibm.com → IAM → API keys.

IBM_WATSONX_PROJECT_ID.description: Your watsonx.ai project ID. Found in your project settings on dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com.

IBM_WATSONX_URL.description: watsonx.ai endpoint URL for your region. e.g. https://au-syd.ml.cloud.ibm.com

IBM_GRANITE_MODEL_ID.description: Model ID to use on watsonx.ai.

DEMO_MODE.description: Set to 'true' to force demo mode (uses sample data, no IBM credentials needed). Leave blank to auto-detect from credentials.

NODE_ENV.description: Set to 'production' to serve the built React frontend from Express on a single port.

PORT.description: Port the server listens on. Heroku sets this automatically.
